items.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer is now available everyone on Mac

items.title: Mira Murati’s deposition pulled back the curtain on Sam Altman’s ouster
items.description: The week leading up to Thanksgiving 2023 was the AI industry's biggest soap opera moment. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman was abruptly ousted from his role at the ChatGPT-maker. The explanation? That Altman was "not consistently candid in his communications with the board." Now, via witness testimony and tria

items.title: Apple’s AirPods with cameras for AI are apparently close to production
items.description: Apple's rumored AirPods with cameras are nearing a stage where the company will test early mass production, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports. items.title: SpaceX has a $55 billion plan to build AI chips in Texas
items.description: Elon Musk's plans to get into the AI chip manufacturing business are going to be costly. As the New York Times and CNBC report, SpaceX is planning to invest at least $55 billion into its "Terafab" chip plant in Austin, Texas. That's according to the details of a public hearing notice filed in Grimes
items.tldr: SpaceXは、テキサス州オースティンに「Terafab」チップ工場を建設するために、少なくとも550億ドルを投資する計画を発表しました。

items.title: Elon Musk’s lawsuit is putting OpenAI’s safety record under the microscope
items.description: Elon Musk's legal effort to dismantle OpenAI may hinge on how its for-profit subsidiary enhances or detracts from the frontier lab's founding mission of ensuring that humanity benefits from artificial general intelligence.
items.tldr: TL;DR: イーロン・マスクの訴訟は、OpenAIの営利子会社が人工一般知能の人類への利益という創設目的にどのように影響を与えているかを問うもので、同社の安全性が注目されている。

items.title: Bumble is getting rid of the swipe, CEO says
items.description: Based on Whitney Wolfe Herd's past comments about Bumble's new direction, the company is expected to lean into AI -- Bumble is even working on an AI dating assistant called Bee, and the CEO has made many comments over the years about how AI will be "a supercharger to love and relationships."
items.tldr: Bumbleはスワイプ機能を廃止し、AIに注力する方針を示しており、AIデーティングアシスタント「Bee」の開発も進めている。

items.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Trusted Contact’ will alert loved ones of safety concerns
items.description: OpenAI is launching an optional safety feature for ChatGPT that allows adult users to assign an emergency contact for mental health and safety concerns. Friends, family members, or caregivers designated as a "Trusted Contact" will be notified if OpenAI detects that a person may have discussed topics
items.tldr: OpenAIは、ChatGPTにおいてユーザーが「Trusted Contact」を設定できるオプションの安全機能を導入し、メンタルヘルスや安全に関する懸念が検出された場合に、指定された連絡先に通知が送られる仕組みを提供します。

items.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
items.description: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are facing off in a high-stakes trial that could alter the future of OpenAI and its most well-known product, ChatGPT. In 2024, Musk filed a lawsuit accusing OpenAI of abandoning its founding mission of developing AI to benefit humanity and shifting focus to boosting profits
items.tldr: サム・アルトマンとイーロン・マスクの法廷闘争が進行中で、OpenAIの未来やChatGPTに大きな影響を与える可能性がある。マスクは、OpenAIが人類の利益のためにAIを開発するという創業の使命を放棄し、利益追求にシフトしたと訴えている。

items.title: Google Staying Committed To Its Tensor Chips For The Pixel 12 Series As Details Of Next-Generation SoC Have Been Spilled
items.description: The Pixel 11 lineup is expected to launch later this year with Google’s Tensor G6, and if you thought that the company is shifting to an alternative like a flagship Snapdragon or MediaTek SoC to gain an upper hand against the competition, you assumed incorrectly. The Mountain View firm is sticking t
items.tldr: GoogleはPixel 12シリーズ向けのTensorチップに引き続きコミットしており、次世代SoCの詳細が明らかになった。Pixel 11ラインアップは今年後半にTensor G6を搭載して発売される予定で、競争に対抗するためにSnapdragonやMediaTekに切り替えることはない。

items.title: Nacon Connect 2026 Pushes Forward With Big Reveals and Updates as Insolvency Threatens Studios Behind the Games
items.description: Today, French publisher Nacon finally hosted its Nacon Connect 2026 showcase event after it was postponed from its original date in March 2026. If you don't recall, it was postponed because Nacon filed for insolvency days after announcing the event, after its majority investor, Big Ben Interactive,
items.tldr: Naconは、2026年のNacon Connectイベントを開催し、ゲームスタジオの破産危機に直面しながらも大きな発表とアップデートを行った。

items.title: Powering the Next American Century: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright and NVIDIA’s Ian Buck on the Genesis Mission
items.description: AI will help build the energy it needs. That’s the case U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright and NVIDIA Vice President of Hyperscale and High-Performance Computing Ian Buck made Thursday morning at the SCSP AI+ Expo. The 30-minute fireside chat, moderated by SCSP president Ylli Bajraktari, was called
items.tldr: 米国エネルギー長官クリス・ライトとNVIDIAのイアン・バックが、AIがエネルギーの未来を支える重要性について議論した。

items.title: AMD announces MI350P PCIe AI accelerator card with 144GB of HBM3E — roughly 40% faster in FP16 and FP8 theoretical compute compared to Nvidia's H200 NVL competitor
items.description: AMD launches a new MI350P PCIe AI-accelerator card with half the cores and memory of its flagship Instinct MI355X GPU. The new card provides customers with a drop-in upgrade solution for existing air-cooled servers.
items.tldr: AMDは、NvidiaのH200 NVLと比較してFP16およびFP8の理論計算速度が約40%速い144GBのHBM3Eを搭載したMI350P PCIe AIアクセラレータカードを発表しました。この新カードは、既存の空冷サーバーへの簡単なアップグレードソリューションを提供します。

items.title: Session Studio Crea-ture Trades Skateboards for Claws With Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn, a 2027 Action-Adventure
items.description: Amidst a period of upheaval for the publisher, Nacon debuted its Nacon Connect 2026 showcase today, which included reveals of previously released titles coming to new platforms, new accessories from Nacon, and the reveal of new games, including Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn. Developed by Nacon
items.tldr: Naconが開催したNacon Connect 2026で、新作アクションアドベンチャーゲーム「Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn」が発表され、他にも新しいプラットフォーム向けのタイトルやアクセサリーが紹介された。

items.title: Cyanide Studio Twists a Classic Gothic Tale in its “Puzzlevania,” Dracula: The Disciple, Arriving in 2027 if Cyanide Survives Insolvency
items.description: Revealed during the Nacon Connect 2026 showcase event, Cyanide Studios' next game following Styx: Blades of Greed, which released earlier this year. This time, Cyanide is once again bringing a classic character back into the spotlight, but this character is much more well-known than a sneaking gobli
items.tldr: Cyanide Studioは、2027年にリリース予定の「Dracula: The Disciple」でクラシックなゴシック物語を新たに解釈し、同時にスタジオの財政問題が解決されることを願っている。

items.title: Valve Introduces Reservation Queue for Steam Controller to Strike Back at Scalpers After an “Incredibly Frustrating” Launch Day
items.description: Valve's launch of its new Steam Controller (2026) went great for the company, in the sense that Valve sold a lot of controllers. The entire run of stock that Valve had set aside for launch completely sold out within half an hour, and while many players were able to grab a controller, plenty more wer
items.tldr: Valveは新しいSteam Controllerの発売日にスカイパー対策として予約キューを導入し、短時間で在庫が完売するほどの人気を博したが、多くのプレイヤーが購入できなかったことに不満を抱いている。

items.title: White House reportedly considers mandatory government vetting of AI models before release — executive order under discussion
items.description: The Trump administration is in early discussions about an executive order that would create a government review process for AI models before public release.
items.tldr: ホワイトハウスは、AIモデルの公開前に政府による必須の審査プロセスを設けるための大統領令を検討している。

items.title: Cold Iron Studios Finally Reveals Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 After Years-Old Leak, Will Deliver More Xenomorph-Killing Action in Summer 2026
items.description: Cold Iron Studios released the first Aliens: Fireteam Elite game back in 2021 to a middling response. Most critics (Wccftech's Kai Tatsumoto included) agreed that it was an alright game overall but missed the mark in several ways. Three years later in July 2024, a major leak practically confirms tha
items.tldr: Cold Iron Studiosは、2026年夏に「Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2」を発表し、さらなるエイリアン討伐アクションを提供することを明らかにしました。前作は賛否が分かれたものの、続編に期待が寄せられています。

items.title: Windows 11 To Get Major Boost In App & UI Performance By Pushing CPUs To Their Max Frequency
items.description: Windows 11 will soon see boosted performance through a new feature that Microsoft is working on, called Low Latency Profile. Maxing Out CPU Clocks For Short Duration Could Help Speed Up Windows 11 Apps & UI Microsoft is actively working towards refining the user experience within its Windows 11
items.tldr: Windows 11は、Low Latency Profileという新機能により、CPUの最大クロックを短時間で引き上げることでアプリとUIのパフォーマンスを向上させる予定です。

items.title: Google Rebrands Fitbit App To Google Health, Replete With A Dedicated AI Health Coach, Announces The $100 Screenless Fitbit Air
items.description: In a series of health-focused announcements, Google has just rebranded the Fitbit app to Google Health, imbuing it with a dedicated AI health coach as well as the ability to work with any health tracker. The tech giant has also announced the $100 screenless Fitbit Air alongside a pricier special edi
items.tldr: GoogleはFitbitアプリをGoogle Healthにリブランドし、専用のAIヘルスコーチを搭載し、すべての健康トラッカーと連携可能にしました。また、100ドルの画面なしFitbit Airも発表しました。

items.title: Real-Time Performance Monitoring and Faster Debugging with NCCL Inspector and Prometheus
items.description: Distributed deep learning depends on fast, reliable GPU-to-GPU communication using the NVIDIA Collective Communication Library (NCCL). When training slows down,...
items.tldr: NVIDIAのNCCL InspectorとPrometheusを使用することで、分散深層学習におけるGPU間通信のリアルタイムパフォーマンス監視と迅速なデバッグが可能になります。

items.title: Crimson Desert Widely Accepts Ideas From The Community, Rejecting Industry’s Fixation With Roadmaps and “Silicon Valley” Ego
items.description: Crimson Desert is receiving excellent post-launch support. In the weeks after the game launched on PC and consoles, Pearl Abyss not only fixed some of the game's most glaring issues but also added new features quickly, including some highly requested by the community, such as the option for strongho
items.tldr: TL;DR: Crimson Desertは、コミュニティからのアイデアを広く受け入れ、業界のロードマップや「シリコンバレー」のエゴに依存せず、優れたポストローンチサポートを提供している。

items.title: Lian Li’s new DK07 Wood motorized standing desk doubles as a dual-PC chassis with support for E-ATX systems and massive cooling setups — five new wood-finished models are available now
items.description: The updated version adds a dark walnut finish while retaining support for dual systems, large GPUs, and extensive cooling setups.
items.tldr: Lian Liの新しいDK07 Woodモーター式スタンディングデスクは、E-ATXシステムと大規模な冷却セットアップをサポートするデュアルPCシャーシとしても機能し、ダークウォルナット仕上げの新モデルが5種類発売されました。

items.title: This PCIe AI Accelerator Card Can Run 700B LLMs Locally With 384 GB Memory at Just 240W, Less Than Half The Power of RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell
items.description: A Taiwanese company has announced its new PCIe AI accelerator card that can run 700B LLMs locally at just 240W, ending the need for large GPU clusters. Taiwanese Company Unveils Its PCIe AI Accelerator That Devalues Large-Scale AI Installations By Running 700B LLMs on A Single Card Skymizer, a Taiwa
items.tldr: 台湾の企業が、384GBのメモリを搭載し、わずか240Wで700BのLLMをローカルで実行できるPCIe AIアクセラレータカードを発表し、大規模なGPUクラスターの必要性を解消しました。

items.title: Motherboard sales 'collapse' by more than 25% as chipmakers strangle enthusiast PC market to build more AI chips — Asus projected to sell 5 million fewer boards in 2025, Gigabyte, MSI, and ASRock also expected to see reduced sales numbers
items.description: The combined sales of the four biggest motherboard manufacturers are expected to fall by at least 28% in 2026, with the entire industry selling 11.7 million less units due to increasing PC component costs.
items.tldr: マザーボードの販売が25%以上減少し、2026年には主要4社の売上が少なくとも28%減少する見込みで、業界全体では1170万台の販売減が予想されている。

items.title: Now 15% off, Razer's fantastic Basilisk V3 Pro wireless mouse with 30K DPI sensor is reduced to clear in this limited deal — 30K DPI sensor, optical switches, and long battery life for only $84
items.description: Grab 15% off the fantastic Razer Bailisk V3 Pro wireless gaming mouse at Woot in this limited clearance sale.
items.tldr: RazerのBasilisk V3 Proワイヤレスマウスが、30K DPIセンサー、光学スイッチ、長いバッテリー寿命を備え、限定セールで15%オフの84ドルで販売中です。

items.title: AMD Intros Instinct MI350P Accelerator: CDNA 4 Comes to PCIe Cards
items.description: AMD has released a PCIe version of its flagship MI350 accelerators, the MI350P. Half of a MI350X, the card is aimed at customers who need to fit an modern AI accelerator into a traditional PCIe server The post AMD Intros Instinct MI350P Accelerator: CDNA 4 Comes to PCIe Cards appeared first on Serve
items.tldr: AMDは、従来のPCIeサーバーに対応したAIアクセラレーターMI350Pを発表しました。これは、MI350Xの半分の性能を持つカードで、CDNA 4アーキテクチャを採用しています。

items.title: Linked and Loaded: Gaijin Single Sign-On Now Available on GeForce NOW
items.description: Less typing, more tanking. Faster logins mean more time in the gaming action — and this week provides GeForce NOW members with a smoother path straight into the battlefield. Cloud gaming is all about instant access to titles across devices, and the latest GeForce NOW update removes another layer for
items.tldr: TL;DR: GeForce NOWの最新アップデートにより、Gaijinのシングルサインオンが利用可能になり、ログインが迅速化され、プレイヤーはよりスムーズにゲームにアクセスできるようになりました。

items.title: Intel Core Ultra 5 225 review: Arrow Lake’s forgotten CPU needs a price cut
items.description: Intel’s Core Ultra 5 225 has been swept under the rug, given the disappointing debut of Arrow Lake, but with a slight price adjustment, it could be a compelling CPU.
items.tldr: IntelのCore Ultra 5 225はArrow Lakeの期待外れなデビューにより注目を浴びていないが、価格を少し調整すれば魅力的なCPUになり得る。

items.title: Has CISA Finally Found Its New Leader in Tom Parker?
items.description: Dark Reading investigates rumors that Tom Parker, a board room "operator" and longtime cyber exec, could be next in line to take over CISA.
items.tldr: CISAの新しいリーダーとして、サイバー業界のベテランであるトム・パーカーが候補に挙がっているという噂が浮上している。

items.title: New PCPJack worm steals credentials, cleans TeamPCP infections
items.description: A new malware framework called PCPJack is stealing credentials from exposed cloud infrastructure while actively removing TeamPCP's access to the systems. [...]
items.tldr: 新しいマルウェアフレームワーク「PCPJack」が、露出したクラウドインフラから認証情報を盗みつつ、TeamPCPのシステムへのアクセスを積極的に削除しています。

items.title: Australia warns of ClickFix attacks pushing Vidar Stealer malware
items.description: The Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) is warning organizations of an ongoing malware campaign using the ClickFix social engineering technique to distribute the Vidar Stealer info-stealing malware. [...]
items.tldr: オーストラリアサイバーセキュリティセンター（ACSC）は、ClickFixソーシャルエンジニアリング手法を利用してVidar Stealer情報窃盗マルウェアを配布する進行中の攻撃について警告しています。

items.title: Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-6973 RCE Under Active Exploitation Grants Admin-Level Access
items.description: Ivanti is warning that a new security flaw impacting Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) has been explored in limited attacks in the wild. The high-severity vulnerability, CVE-2026-6973 (CVSS score: 7.2), is a case of improper input validation affecting EPMM before versions 12.6.1.1, 12.7.0.1, and 12.8.0
items.tldr: Ivantiは、Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)に影響を与える新たなセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2026-6973が、限定的な攻撃で悪用されていることを警告しており、特にバージョン12.6.1.1、12.7.0.1、12.8.0以前のEPMMにおいて不適切な入力検証が原因であるとされています。

items.title: PCPJack Credential Stealer Exploits 5 CVEs to Spread Worm-Like Across Cloud Systems
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a new credential theft framework dubbed PCPJack that targets exposed cloud infrastructure and ousts any artifacts linked to TeamPCP from the environments. "The toolset harvests credentials from cloud, container, developer, productivity, and financi
items.tldr: PCPJackという新しい認証情報窃盗フレームワークが、露出したクラウドインフラを標的にし、TeamPCPに関連するアーティファクトを排除しながら、5つのCVEを利用してワームのように広がることが報告されました。

items.title: Ivanti warns of new EPMM flaw exploited in zero-day attacks
items.description: Ivanti warned customers today to patch a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability in Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) exploited in zero-day attacks. [...]
items.tldr: Ivantiは、ゼロデイ攻撃で悪用されているEndpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)の高危険度のリモートコード実行脆弱性を修正するよう顧客に警告しました。

items.title: The Browser Is Breaking Your DLP: How Data Slips Past Modern Controls
items.description: Your security controls aren't failing, they're missing where most of today's work actually happens. Keep Aware shows how browser activity like copy/paste and AI prompts bypass traditional protections. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: 現代のセキュリティコントロールは失敗しているのではなく、実際の作業が行われるブラウザ活動（コピー＆ペーストやAIプロンプトなど）を見逃しているため、データ漏洩が発生している。

items.title: One Click, Total Shutdown: The "Patient Zero" Webinar on Killing Stealth Breaches
items.description: The hardest part of cybersecurity isn't the technology, it’s the people. Every major breach you’ve read about lately usually starts the same way: one employee, one clever email, and one "Patient Zero" infection. In 2026, hackers are using AI to make these "first clicks" nearly impossible to spot. If
items.tldr: サイバーセキュリティの最大の課題は技術ではなく人間であり、最近の大規模な侵害は「Patient Zero」となる従業員の一つのクリックから始まることが多い。2026年には、ハッカーがAIを利用してこの「最初のクリック」を見つけることをほぼ不可能にしている。

items.title: Americans sentenced for running 'laptop farms' for North Korea
items.description: Two U.S. nationals were sentenced to 18 months in prison each for operating so-called laptop farms that helped North Korean IT workers fraudulently obtain remote employment at nearly 70 American companies. [...]
items.tldr: アメリカ人2名が、北朝鮮のIT労働者が約70のアメリカ企業で不正にリモート雇用を得る手助けをした「ラップトップファーム」を運営したとして、それぞれ18ヶ月の懲役刑を言い渡されました。

items.title: PAN-OS RCE Exploit Under Active Use Enabling Root Access and Espionage
items.description: Palo Alto Networks has disclosed that threat actors may have attempted to unsuccessfully exploit a recently disclosed critical security flaw as early as April 9, 2026. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-0300 (CVSS score: 9.3/8.7), a buffer overflow vulnerability in the User-ID Authentication
items.tldr: Palo Alto Networksは、CVE-2026-0300というユーザーID認証のバッファオーバーフロー脆弱性が悪用され、ルートアクセスや情報収集を可能にする攻撃が試みられたことを報告しました。

items.title: 'TrustFall' Convention Exposes Claude Code Execution Risk
items.description: Malicious repositories can trigger code execution in Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, and CoPilot CLI with minimal or no user interaction, thanks to skimpy warning dialogs.
items.tldr: TL;DR: 悪意のあるリポジトリが、ユーザーの最小限または無操作でClaude Code、Cursor CLI、Gemini CLI、CoPilot CLIにおいてコード実行を引き起こすリスクがあることが、'TrustFall'コンベンションで明らかになった。

items.title: World's First AI-Driven Cyberattack Couldn't Breach OT Systems
items.description: The most sophisticated AI-integrated campaign to date hit a brick wall in the form of a SCADA login screen.
items.tldr: 世界初のAI駆動のサイバー攻撃が、SCADAのログイン画面に阻まれOTシステムに侵入できなかった。

items.title: Crypto gang member gets 6.5 years for role in $230 million heist
items.description: A 20-year-old California man was sentenced to 78 months in prison for serving as a home invader and money launderer in a criminal ring that stole over $250 million in cryptocurrency. [...]
items.tldr: カリフォルニア州の20歳男性が、2億3千万ドル以上の暗号通貨を盗んだ犯罪組織の一員として、78ヶ月の懲役刑を言い渡されました。

items.title: Webinar: Why modern attacks require both security and recovery
items.description: Modern attacks don't stop at initial compromise. This webinar explores why security and recovery must work together to reduce downtime and improve resilience. [...]
items.tldr: 現代の攻撃は初期の侵害にとどまらず、セキュリティとリカバリーが連携することでダウンタイムを減少させ、レジリエンスを向上させる必要があることを探るウェビナーです。

items.title: ThreatsDay Bulletin: Edge Plaintext Passwords, ICS 0-Days, Patch-or-Die Alerts and 25+ New Stories
items.description: Bad week. Turns out the easiest way to get hacked in 2026 is still the same old garbage: shady packages, fake apps, forgotten DNS junk, scam ads, and stolen logins getting dumped into Discord channels like it’s normal. Some of these attack chains don’t even feel sophisticated anymore. More like some
items.tldr: TL;DR: 2026年にハッキングされる最も簡単な方法は、怪しいパッケージや偽アプリ、忘れられたDNS、詐欺広告、盗まれたログイン情報の流出など、依然として古典的な手法であることが明らかになった。

items.title: Smart Glasses for the Authorities
items.description: ICE is developing its own version of smart glasses, with facial recognition tied to various databases.
items.tldr: ICEが顔認識機能を搭載した独自のスマートグラスを開発中で、複数のデータベースと連携する予定です。

items.title: Palo Alto Networks firewall zero-day exploited for nearly a month
items.description: Palo Alto Networks warned customers that suspected state-sponsored hackers have been exploiting a critical-severity PAN-OS firewall zero-day vulnerability for nearly a month. [...]
items.tldr: Palo Alto Networksは、国家支援のハッカーが約1か月間、PAN-OSファイアウォールのクリティカルなゼロデイ脆弱性を悪用していると警告しました。

items.title: Day Zero Readiness: The Operational Gaps That Break Incident Response
items.description: Having an incident response retainer, or even a pre-approved external incident response firm, is not the same as being ready for an incident. A retainer means someone will answer the phone. Operational readiness determines whether that team can do meaningful work the moment they do.  That disti
items.tldr: TL;DR: インシデントレスポンスの準備には、契約した外部企業がいるだけでは不十分で、実際に効果的に対応できる運用体制が必要である。

items.title: Fake Claude AI website delivers new 'Beagle' Windows malware
items.description: A fake version for the Claude AI website offers a malicious Claude-Pro Relay download that pushes a previously undocumented backdoor for Windows named Beagle. [...]
items.tldr: 偽のClaude AIウェブサイトが、Windows用の新しいマルウェア「Beagle」をインストールする悪意のあるClaude-Pro Relayを提供しています。

items.title: PyPI Packages Deliver ZiChatBot Malware via Zulip APIs on Windows and Linux
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered three packages on the Python Package Index (PyPI) repository that are designed to stealthily deliver a previously unknown malware family called ZiChatBot on Windows and Linux systems. "While these wheel packages do implement the features described on th
items.tldr: PyPIにおいて、WindowsとLinuxシステムにZiChatBotという未知のマルウェアを密かに配信するために設計された3つのパッケージが発見された。
